items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Yeah, I know him. Yeah, he was good too.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I know who you're speaking about now. Yeah, I know him. Yeah, he was a good piano player. He was good too. He was good. Now they had several piano players that I'm not calling their name because they wasn't the real, the best. You know, I'm not calling them all, but not really the best.
Professor Minetta told us about a fellow that stayed on the other side of the river. He said he was really wonderful, Gusty O'Neal. Did you ever hear him?
Yeah, I know him. Yeah, he was good too.
